description: Bare Git reconciliation call: preserves the accepted manuscript revision and run history without unsolicited creative rewriting.

text: TASK: the accepted plan computed a wipe boundary. The repository remains at
accepted_revision; the driver has performed no rewind, apply, merge, or conflict
resolution. Own the run-scoped Git reconciliation and final same-branch commit.
Preserve required pre-boundary history, the accepted manuscript revision, and every
accepted creative or editorial intent; remove only unwound work. Do not turn merge
repair into an unsolicited rewrite or change voice, structure, character, continuity,
pacing, theme, or title beyond the supplied reconciliation account.
Leave a clean repository with one valid canonical plan block. You may update that block
only as reconciliation requires and must finish it in this call. If impossible, return
blocked and leave the repository in the final state you can account for.
The final run-owned history must be linear. With a wipe boundary, it is an ancestor of
final HEAD and invalidated recorded commits are absent from final HEAD ancestry. Without
one, accepted_revision is an ancestor of final HEAD and there are no invalidations.
These are revision checks, not proof of literary quality or permission for creative change.
WHAT HAPPENED
- wipe reason: {{wipe_reason}}
- wipe_boundary: {{wipe_boundary}}
- source call: {{source_kind}}
- source_base_revision ({{source_base_role}}): {{source_base_revision}}
- accepted_revision: {{accepted_revision}}
- source range: {{source_base_revision}}..{{accepted_revision}}
- opening reconciliation account (original old plan/run boundaries and opening wipe/requeue/checkpoint effects): {{opening_reconciliation_account}}
- required outcome: {{required_outcome}}

variables.name: wipe_reason
variables.description: Why the plan computed a wipe boundary and which manuscript or editorial units were unwound or requeued.

variables.name: wipe_boundary
variables.description: Computed opening boundary; the repository has not been rewound to it.

variables.name: source_base_role
variables.description: pre_session_commit for Brainstorming; pre_call_commit for a direct agent call

variables.name: source_base_revision
variables.description: Commit captured before the accepted plan-changing call; source-range start and never the wipe boundary by implication.

variables.name: accepted_revision
variables.description: Source-range end and dispatch HEAD: closed_ready_HEAD for Brainstorming, or the driver's accepted-result commit for a direct call.

variables.name: opening_reconciliation_account
variables.description: Persisted original plan and run boundaries, source range, and opening wipe, requeue, and checkpoint account.

variables.name: required_outcome
variables.description: Required preserved history and accepted literary intent, removed unwound work, valid final block, clean branch, and final commit.

questions.status: bare technical kind — no battery by design (decision 57)

text: OUTPUT CONTRACT
Return exactly one JSON object, nothing else:
{"status": "ok" | "blocked",
"kind": "merge_repair",
"files_changed": ["<workspace-relative paths you touched>", ...],
"blocked_reason": "<required when blocked: what cannot be reconciled>",
"notes": "<optional, short>"}
